notes: Staff can manage optional organization-wide and service-need notification preferences from Staff Notifications.
Staff Account and Role Assignments now uses clearer access, notification, report, event, and saved-assignment sections with compact summaries.
Direct youth, task, referral, case plan, and event assignments continue to notify assigned staff while explicit notification opt-outs are respected.
Scheduled intakes can be created without a birth date, and existing youth intake links can be copied or resent without creating a new packet.
